notes: >-

  Conformance Report.


  Method scope is web-only. Only the "web" component is populated from this
  engagement's evidence; the electronic-docs, software, and authoring-tool
  components are omitted from every criterion entry, and the Revised Section
  508 chapters (Functional Performance Criteria, Hardware, Software, Support
  Documentation and Services) are disabled with coverage-boundary notes rather
  than answered.


  All 56 Level A and Level AA criteria in this catalog carry a term derived
  from the evaluation's per-criterion outcome map; none was left untested. The
  follow-up session of 2026-07-28 closed 3.1.2 Language of Parts, the one
  criterion open at the end of the base window.


  Every term is sample-scoped. Terms come from the outcome map across the
  WCAG-EM sample set (11 structured + 1 random web samples + the web complete
  process P01), never from finding severity; impact language appears in the
  remarks only. WCAG-EM sampling characterizes the evaluated pages and
  processes and does not by itself support a conformance claim for the whole
  product.

  here. (1) RideRC native app, complete process P02, manual TalkBack and
  VoiceOver session of 2026-07-15: the icon-only "Activate ticket" control is
  unlabeled under both screen readers, with a labeled long-press fallback
  available — finding a11y_ticket_activate_unlabeled, fingerprint 0d6b93aa.

  PDFs are untagged, with no structural tags and no programmatic reading
  order — finding a11y_timetable_pdf_untagged, fingerprint b1590f3e. Both sit
  outside the web measurement stack; see the disabled Software chapter and

  the engagement letter (vendor-supplied, documented, not remediable this
  cycle). It was not evaluated and no criterion result covers it.

  seed 7391) + 2 complete processes (P01 plan trip to purchased monthly pass

  Firefox 141 (Windows 11); VoiceOver + Safari 18 (macOS 15); TalkBack 15 +
  Chrome (Android 15); keyboard-only without a screen reader. Technologies
  relied upon: HTML, CSS, JavaScript (React), WAI-ARIA.
